note: Seth Ji ke Case - reasoning cases (founder, 15 Nov): four answers that all look right, one that survives careful thought, in everyday Pakistani Roman Urdu. The CLUES are red herrings (founder, 15 Nov: 'overwhelming, so the player makes a mistake'): three pull hard toward wrong answers, one quiet clue helps. Clues never change the logic - a careful thinker still has exactly one most-correct answer. After the verdict, 'Jaal' names the trap. The founder approves each case (approved: true) before it is played live. Medical and aviation cases are famous moments from history, told as stories - never advice.

cases.title: Tala Nahi Toota
cases.brief: Jeweller ki shop se raat ko zewar chori ho gaye. Tala nahi toota. Sub-inspector kehta hai: 'Tala bilkul theek hai, matlab chor shop ka apna staff hai - chabi sirf 3 staff walon ke paas hoti hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat sub-inspector ki is baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Pichle mahine tala lagane wale mistri ne ek extra chabi apne paas rakh li thi.
Teeno staff wale 5 saal se kaam kar rahe hain aur kabhi koi shikayat nahi aayi.
Shop ka alarm ek hafte se kharab tha.
Chori hone wale zewar staff ki kai saal ki salary se zyada mehngay the.
cases.answer: Pichle mahine tala lagane wale mistri ne ek extra chabi apne paas rakh li thi.

clues.label: Lie-detector test
clues.text: Teeno staff walon ka lie-detector test hua - teeno ke results bilkul saaf aaye.

clues.label: Imran ka qarz
clues.text: Staff ke Imran pe 8 lakh ka qarz tha. Chori ke agle hi din us ne poora qarz utaar diya.

clues.label: Alarm ki shikayat
clues.text: Alarm ek hafte se kharab tha, lekin kisi ne repair ki shikayat nahi ki. Owner kehta hai: 'Yeh staff ka hi kaam hai.'

clues.label: Tale ka bill
clues.text: Pichle mahine shop ka tala badla gaya tha. Mistri ka bill: Rs 3,500, kaam 2 din chala.

cases.explain:
Inspector ki poori baat is pe khari thi ke chabi sirf staff ke paas hai. Extra chabi wali baat yeh buniyad hi khatam kar deti hai. Saaf record sirf achi image hai, aur alarm ka tale se koi taalluq nahi.

🪤 *Jaal:* Imran ka qarz aur lie-detector sirf shak ya bharosa barhate hain - chabi kis ke paas thi, yeh sawal hal nahi karte.

cases.title: Dulhan ka Haar
cases.brief:
Shadi wale ghar se dulhan ka haar gayab hai. Kamre mein sirf 3 log gaye the aur haar in hi mein se ek ne liya. Police ko pakka pata hai ke teeno mein se sirf EK sach bol raha hai.
Shabana: 'Haar Bilal ne liya.'
Bilal: 'Main ne nahi liya.'
Hina: 'Main ne nahi liya.'
cases.question: Haar kis ne liya?
options: Hina ne
Bilal ne
Shabana ne
Pata nahi chal sakta, maloomat kam hai
cases.answer: Hina ne

clues.label: Bilal ki jeb
clues.text: Bilal ki jeb se dulhan ki chooriyon ka khali dabba mila. Woh kehta hai dabba farsh pe gira para tha.

clues.label: Shabana ka maazi
clues.text: Shabana ko pichle saal ek ghar se chori ke shak mein kaam se nikala gaya tha.

clues.label: Hina ke aansu
clues.text: Hina dulhan ki sab se pyari cousin hai. Shadi ki saari tayyari usi ne ki, aur sab se zyada woh hi ro rahi hai.

clues.label: Shadi ki video
clues.text: Kamre ka ek hi darwaza hai. Shadi ki video mein teeno bari bari andar jate dikh rahe hain.

cases.explain:
Bilal chor ho toh Shabana aur Hina dono sach bolte hain. Shabana chor ho toh Bilal aur Hina dono sach bolte hain. Sirf Hina chor ho toh akela Bilal sach bolta hai - aur shart yehi thi ke sach sirf ek bol raha hai.

🪤 *Jaal:* Chooriyon ka dabba, Shabana ka maazi aur Hina ke aansu - teeno sirf dhyan bhatkane ke liye the. Jawab sirf logic se nikalta hai.

cases.title: Jahaz ki Bimari
cases.brief: Saal 1747. Lambe samandari safar mein jahaz ke staff ke masooron se khoon aa raha hai aur zakhm theek nahi ho rahe. Jahaz ke doctor James Lind ko lagta hai: 'Yeh bimari taza phal na milne se hoti hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat doctor ke khayal ko sab se zyada pakka karti hai?
options: Jin 2 mareezon ko roz malte diye gaye woh theek ho gaye; baqi wohi khana kha ke bimar rahe.
Afsar, jin ka khana acha hota hai, staff se kam bimar hote hain.
Port pe pohanch ke zyada tar log chand din mein theek ho jate hain.
Yeh bimari sirf lambe safar mein hoti hai, chhote safar mein nahi.
cases.answer: Jin 2 mareezon ko roz malte diye gaye woh theek ho gaye; baqi wohi khana kha ke bimar rahe.

clues.label: Afsaron ki sehat
clues.text: Afsaron ke khane mein roz taza phal aur sabzi hoti thi - aur 6 mahine mein ek bhi afsar bimar nahi hua.

clues.label: Port ka record
clues.text: Pichle 3 safar mein jahaz jab bhi port pe ruka, 10 din ke andar 90% mareez theek ho gaye.

clues.label: Chhote safar
clues.text: Jo jahaz sirf 2 hafte ka safar karte hain, un mein yeh bimari aaj tak ek dafa bhi nahi hui.

clues.label: Test ki list
clues.text: Test mein 12 mareez the. Har 2 ko alag cheez di gayi: sirka, samandari paani, jau ka paani... aur 2 ko malte.

cases.explain:
Sirf malton wale test mein baqi sab kuch same tha aur ek hi cheez badli. Afsar, port aur lamba safar - teeno mein kai cheezein ek saath badalti hain, is liye wajah pakki nahi hoti. Yeh duniya ke pehle mashhoor medical test mein se ek mana jata hai.

🪤 *Jaal:* Afsaron, port aur chhote safar wale clue bohat strong lagte hain, lekin har ek mein kai cheezein ek saath badal rahi thin.

cases.title: London ka Nalka
cases.brief: Saal 1854, London ka ek mohalla. Haize (cholera) se saikron log mar gaye. Sarkari doctor: 'Bimari gandi hawa se phailti hai - dekho, maut badbu wale mohallon mein hi ho rahi hai.' Dr John Snow ko shak hai ke wajah paani hai.
cases.question: Kaunsi baat 'gandi hawa' wali theory ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Usi badbu wali gali ki factory ke 70 mazdoor, jo apne kuein ka paani peete hain, sab theek hain.
Zyada tar maut Broad Street ke nalke ke qareeb wale gharon mein hui hai.
Jin ameer ilaqon mein badbu kam hai, wahan maut bhi kam hai.
Nalke ka paani dekhne mein bilkul saaf hai.
cases.answer: Usi badbu wali gali ki factory ke 70 mazdoor, jo apne kuein ka paani peete hain, sab theek hain.

clues.label: Maut ka naqsha
clues.text: 500 mein se 400 maut Broad Street ke nalke ke 200 gaz ke andar hui.

clues.label: Saaf ilaqe
clues.text: Jahan gutter band hain aur badbu nahi, wahan poore saal haize ka sirf ek case hua.

clues.label: Paani ki report
clues.text: Nalke ka paani check hua - rang, khushbu aur taste, teeno bilkul theek.

clues.label: Factory ka register
clues.text: Factory ke mazdooron ko roz muft beer milti thi, aur factory ke andar apna kuan hai.

cases.explain:
Mazdoor wohi hawa lete the lekin paani alag peete the - aur bach gaye. Nalke ke qareeb maut hawa se bhi samjhayi ja sakti hai, is liye woh hawa wali theory ko galat sabit nahi karti. Dr Snow ne nalka band karwaya aur bimari ruk gayi.

🪤 *Jaal:* Naqsha nalke ki taraf ishara karta hai, lekin badbu bhi wahi thi - is liye woh hawa wali theory ko galat sabit nahi karta.

cases.title: Gawah ki Gawahi
cases.brief: Gawah: 'Main ne raat 11 baje mulzim ko dukaan se nikalte dekha.' Sarkari wakeel: 'Gawah ki mulzim se koi dushmani nahi, usay jhoot bolne ka koi faida nahi. Is liye us ki gawahi bilkul sahi hai.' Aap mulzim ke wakeel hain.
cases.question: Sarkari wakeel ki logic mein sab se bari galti kya hai?
options: Dushmani na ho toh banda jhoot nahi bolta - lekin pehchanne mein galti phir bhi ho sakti hai.
Sirf ek gawah ki gawahi pe kisi ko saza nahi ho sakti.
Mulzim kehta hai ke woh us waqt apne ghar pe tha.
Sarkari wakeel ne gawah se zyada sawal nahi poochhe.
cases.answer: Dushmani na ho toh banda jhoot nahi bolta - lekin pehchanne mein galti phir bhi ho sakti hai.

clues.label: Gawah ka record
clues.text: Gawah school teacher hai, 20 saal mein kabhi kisi case mein nahi aaya. Poora mohalla us ki imandari ki qasam khata hai.

clues.label: Mulzim ki biwi
clues.text: Mulzim ki biwi kehti hai woh raat 10 baje se ghar pe so raha tha.

clues.label: Purane faisle
clues.text: Purane faislon mein likha hai: 'Ek gawah pe saza dene se pehle adalat ko bohat ehtiyaat karni chahiye.'

clues.label: Khirki ka faasla
clues.text: Gawah ki khirki dukaan se 60 gaz door hai. Us raat bahar ki street light jal rahi thi.

cases.explain:
Wakeel ne 'jhoot nahi bol raha' ko 'galti nahi kar raha' samajh liya. Imandaar aadmi bhi andhere mein kisi aur ko mulzim samajh sakta hai. Baqi teeno baatein wakeel ki logic ko touch hi nahi kartin.

🪤 *Jaal:* Gawah jitna imandaar dikhaya gaya, utna hi asal galti chhupti gayi: imandaar aadmi bhi 60 gaz door se galat pehchan sakta hai.

cases.title: Wasiyat ka Kaghaz
cases.brief: Wasiyat pe date 14 August 1995 likhi hai; sari jaidad naukar ke naam. Lab ki report: kaghaz us mill ka hai jo 2003 mein khuli; ink 1990 se market mein hai; signature Seth sahab ke asli signature se milta hai.
cases.question: In baaton se kaunsi cheez 100% pakki hai?
options: Yeh kaghaz 14 August 1995 ko likha hi nahi ja sakta tha.
Signature naqli hai.
Yeh wasiyat naukar ne khud banayi.
Seth sahab apni jaidad naukar ko nahi dena chahte the.
cases.answer: Yeh kaghaz 14 August 1995 ko likha hi nahi ja sakta tha.

clues.label: Naukar ka naya ghar
clues.text: Seth sahab ki wafaat se ek mahina pehle naukar ne Rs 2 crore ka naya ghar book karwaya.

clues.label: Signature expert
clues.text: Expert: 'Signature mein haath halka sa kaanpta hua lagta hai - jaise kisi ne dhyan se copy kiya ho.'

clues.label: Purani recording
clues.text: Bete ke paas Seth sahab ki 2010 ki recording hai: 'Meri jaidad mere bachon ki hai.'

clues.label: Mill ki website
clues.text: Mill ki website: 'Hum 2003 se Pakistan ko kaghaz de rahe hain.'

cases.explain:
Report se sirf itna pakka hai ke date galat hai - 1995 mein yeh kaghaz bana hi nahi tha. Signature asli ho sakta hai aur likhne wala koi bhi ho sakta hai. Baqi teeno jawab report se aage ki baat karte hain.

🪤 *Jaal:* Naukar ka ghar, kaanpta signature aur purani recording - sab shak barhate hain, lekin 100% pakka sirf date ka galat hona hai.

cases.title: Aakhri Over
cases.brief: Final ka aakhri over. Doosri team ko 8 run chahiye aur crease pe Zaheer hai. Coach ka mashwara: 'Ball spinner Imad ko do. Aaj us ne 3 over mein sirf 12 run diye - woh hamara sab se acha bowler raha.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat coach ke mashware ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Imad ke teeno over tab hue jab Zaheer crease pe nahi tha - aur Zaheer spin ko bohat maarta hai.
Aakhri over mein bowler pe pressure bohat zyada hota hai.
Fast bowler Hassan ne aaj 2 wicket li hain.
Imad team ka sab se kam umar bowler hai.
cases.answer: Imad ke teeno over tab hue jab Zaheer crease pe nahi tha - aur Zaheer spin ko bohat maarta hai.

clues.label: Commentators
clues.text: Commentators keh rahe hain: 'Final ka aakhri over hai - jo bhi bowl karega, us ke haath kaanpenge.'

clues.label: Hassan ki form
clues.text: Hassan ne aaj 2 wicket li hain aur pichle 5 match ke aakhri over mein ek bhi chhakka nahi khaya.

clues.label: Imad ki umar
clues.text: Imad sirf 19 saal ka hai aur yeh us ka pehla final hai.

clues.label: Aaj ka scorecard
clues.text: Imad: 3 over, 12 run, 1 wicket. Zaheer: 70 run, 41 ball, 4 chhakke.

cases.explain:
Coach ki baat '12 run' pe khari hai. Lekin woh run doosre batsmen ke khilaf the, Zaheer ke nahi - aur Zaheer spin ko maarta hai. Yani coach ka saboot aaj ke aakhri over pe fit hi nahi hota.

🪤 *Jaal:* Hassan ki form aur Imad ki umar dilchasp hain, lekin coach ki baat '12 run' pe thi - aur woh run Zaheer ke khilaf the hi nahi.

cases.title: Toss ka Faisla
cases.brief: Semi-final ka toss aap jeet gaye. Vice captain: 'Is ground pe pichle 10 match mein 8 dafa baad mein batting karne wali team jeeti hai. Is liye hum pehle bowling karenge toh hamare jeetne ka chance zyada hai.'
cases.question: Vice captain ne kaunsi baat bina saboot ke maan li hai?
options: Woh 8 teamein baad mein batting ki wajah se jeetin - waise hi zyada achi teamein nahi thin.
Aaj raat ground pe os (dew) zaroor giregi.
Hamari bowling hamari batting se achi hai.
Doosri team pressure mein acha nahi khelti.
cases.answer: Woh 8 teamein baad mein batting ki wajah se jeetin - waise hi zyada achi teamein nahi thin.

clues.label: Mausam ki report
clues.text: Mausam ka mehkma: aaj raat 9 baje ke baad ground pe bohat os giregi.

clues.label: Hamare bowler
clues.text: Hamari team ke 3 bowler world ranking ke top 20 mein hain; batsman sirf ek.

clues.label: Doosri team
clues.text: Doosri team ne is saal 5 dafa bara score chase kiya aur 4 dafa haari.

clues.label: Purane 10 match
clues.text: Is ground ke pichle 10 match ki list: kuch badi teamein, kuch chhoti teamein.

cases.explain:
Record tabhi kaam ka hai jab jeetne ki wajah 'baad mein batting' ho. Agar woh teamein waise hi behtar thin toh record se kuch pata nahi chalta. Os ek wajah ho sakti hai, lekin vice captain ki baat us pe khari nahi.

🪤 *Jaal:* Os, hamari bowling aur doosri team ka record - teeno pehle bowling ke haq mein lagte hain, lekin vice captain ki baat in pe khari hi nahi thi.

cases.title: Darya ya Runway
cases.brief: January 2009: takeoff ke 2 minute baad parinde takraye aur dono engine band ho gaye. Captain ne jahaz Hudson darya pe utaar diya; 155 log bach gaye. Baad mein inquiry committee ne kaha: 'Captain ka faisla galat tha - simulator mein pilot wapis airport pohanch gaye the.'
cases.question: Aap Captain hain. Kaunsi baat committee ki baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Simulator ke pilot ko pehle se pata tha kya hoga; asal mein situation samajhne mein 35 second lage.
Darya pe utarna bhi bohat khatarnak tha - paani barf jaisa thanda tha.
Jahaz mein 155 log the, is liye risk nahi liya ja sakta tha.
Captain ke paas 40 saal ka experience tha.
cases.answer: Simulator ke pilot ko pehle se pata tha kya hoga; asal mein situation samajhne mein 35 second lage.

clues.label: Darya ka paani
clues.text: Us din Hudson ka paani 2 degree tha. Is paani mein 10 minute mein insaan behosh ho jata hai.

clues.label: Passengers
clues.text: Jahaz mein 155 log the, jin mein ek bacha sirf 9 mahine ka tha.

clues.label: Captain ki file
clues.text: Captain 40 saal se jahaz chala raha tha aur glider pilot bhi tha - kabhi koi accident nahi kiya.

clues.label: Simulator ka test
clues.text: Simulator mein 20 dafa test hua. Pilot ne har dafa takkar ke foran baad jahaz mor diya.

cases.explain:
Committee ki poori baat simulator pe khari hai - aur simulator asal situation jaisa nahi tha. Jab us mein insaan ke sochne ke 35 second dale gaye toh jahaz airport nahi pohanch saka. Yeh asli waqia hai: 'Miracle on the Hudson'.

🪤 *Jaal:* Thanda paani aur 155 log jazbaati clue hain, aur captain ka experience bharosa dilata hai - lekin committee ki baat sirf simulator pe thi.

cases.title: Fuel Khatam
cases.brief: 1983: ek jahaz ka fuel beech hawa mein khatam ho gaya. Fuel ka meter kharab tha, is liye staff ne haath se hisaab lagaya - aur litre ko kilo ki jagah pound se multiply kar diya. Airline: 'Galti sirf staff ki hai; hisaab unhon ne galat kiya.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat airline ki is baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Airline ne usi mahine pound ki jagah kilo ka system shuru kiya aur staff ko training nahi di.
Hisaab do logon ne mil ke lagaya tha, ek ne nahi.
Pilot ne baghair engine ke jahaz safe utaar liya.
Pilot ne khud bhi hisaab dobara check kiya tha.
cases.answer: Airline ne usi mahine pound ki jagah kilo ka system shuru kiya aur staff ko training nahi di.

clues.label: Do signature
clues.text: Fuel ka hisaab do logon ne mil ke lagaya, aur dono ne us pe apne signature kiye.

clues.label: Safe landing
clues.text: Pilot ne bina engine ke 69 logon ko safe utaara - sab ne us ki tareef ki.

clues.label: Pilot ka OK
clues.text: Pilot ne khud bhi hisaab dobara dekha aur form pe 'OK' likh diya.

clues.label: Jahaz ka model
clues.text: Yeh airline ka bilkul naya jahaz tha - sirf 3 mahine purana.

cases.explain:
Agar airline ne system badla aur training nahi di, toh galti 'sirf staff ki' nahi rehti - airline ki bhi hai. Baqi teeno baatein galti ko staff se bahar nahi le jatin. Yeh asli waqia hai: 'Gimli Glider', sab log bach gaye.

🪤 *Jaal:* Do signature aur pilot ka OK galti ko staff pe hi pakka karte lagte hain - asal sawal yeh tha ke naya system diya, training kyun nahi di.

cases.title: Building mein Aag
cases.brief: 5 manzil ki building ki teesri manzil pe aag lagi hai; chauthi manzil pe 6 log phanse hain. Naya officer: 'Sab ko foran seerhiyon se neeche bhejo. Seerhiyan pakki hain aur aag abhi wahan nahi pohanchi - yeh sab se safe raasta hai.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat is order ka sab se bara khatra dikhati hai?
options: Aag mein zyada log dhuein se marte hain, aur dhuan seerhiyon se hi upar charhta hai.
Seerhiyan tang hain; 6 log ek saath nahi utar sakte.
Phanse hue logon mein ek buzurg hain jo aahista chalte hain.
Building ki lift band ho chuki hai.
cases.answer: Aag mein zyada log dhuein se marte hain, aur dhuan seerhiyon se hi upar charhta hai.

clues.label: Seerhi ki chaurai
clues.text: Seerhi sirf 3 feet chauri hai aur us mein 2 jagah mor hain.

clues.label: 82 saal ke buzurg
clues.text: Phanse logon mein 82 saal ke ek buzurg hain jo walker ke baghair nahi chal sakte.

clues.label: Lift ka button
clues.text: Lift ka button abhi bhi jal raha hai aur lift chauthi manzil pe khari hai.

clues.label: Teesri manzil
clues.text: Teesri manzil ke flat ka darwaza khula hai. Ab tak aag sirf ek flat mein hai.

cases.explain:
Officer ne sirf aag ko khatra samjha. Asal qatil dhuan hai, aur woh seerhiyon mein hi bharta hai - 'aag wahan nahi pohanchi' ka matlab 'safe' nahi. Tang seerhi aur buzurg sirf speed kam karte hain.

🪤 *Jaal:* Tang seerhi, buzurg aur chalti lift - sab dhyan kheenchte hain. Khula darwaza yaad rakhna tha: dhuan wahin se seerhiyon mein jata hai.

cases.title: Sailaab ka Faisla
cases.brief: Sailaab mein aap ki boat mein 6 logon ki jagah hai. Masjid ki pakki chhat pe 20 log hain (paani abhi 6 foot neeche hai). Ek kache ghar mein 5 log hain (deewaron mein dararein par gayi hain). Ek darakht pe ek jawan larka hai (rassi se bandha hua). Aap ne boat pehle kache ghar bheji.
cases.question: Aap ka faisla kis rule pe sab se zyada fit baithta hai?
options: Pehle un ko bachao jin ki jaan ko sab se jaldi khatra hai.
Pehle wahan jao jahan sab se zyada log phanse hain.
Pehle bachon aur buzurgon ko bachao.
Pehle un ko bachao jin tak pohanchna sab se aasan hai.
cases.answer: Pehle un ko bachao jin ki jaan ko sab se jaldi khatra hai.

clues.label: Masjid pe log
clues.text: Masjid ki chhat pe 20 log hain - kache ghar se 4 guna zyada.

clues.label: Kache ghar mein
clues.text: Kache ghar mein 2 bachay aur ek 80 saal ki amma hain.

clues.label: Darakht wala larka
clues.text: Darakht wala larka madad ke liye chilla raha hai aur us ki maa kinare pe ro rahi hai.

clues.label: Engineer ki baat
clues.text: Engineer ne kache ghar ki deewaron ki photo dekh ke kaha: 'Dararein taza hain aur barh rahi hain.'

cases.explain:
Faisla 'kis ko sab se pehle khatra hai' pe tha: kacha ghar girne wala hai, baqi dono abhi safe hain. Ginti wala rule boat ko masjid bhejta aur aasani wala rule darakht pe - sirf 'sab se jaldi khatra' wala rule is faisle pe fit hota hai.

🪤 *Jaal:* Bachay aur amma wala clue sab se zyada kheenchta hai - lekin masjid pe bhi bachay aur buzurg the. Faisla sirf 'kaun pehle doobega' se samajh aata hai.

cases.title: Do Chabiyon ki Tijori
cases.brief: Bank ki tijori sirf tab khulti hai jab do chabiyan ek saath lagein: ek manager ki, ek cashier ki. Kal raat tijori khuli aur 50 lakh gayab ho gaye; tala nahi toota. Manager: 'Meri chabi poori raat meri jeb mein thi.'
cases.question: Agar manager sach bol raha hai, toh kaunsi baat 100% pakki hai?
options: Ya toh manager khud tijori pe maujood tha, ya us ki chabi ki duplicate ban chuki hai.
Manager ki chabi ki duplicate zaroor ban chuki hai.
Chori cashier ne ki, kyunke doosri chabi usi ke paas thi.
Chori mein kam az kam do log shamil the.
cases.answer: Ya toh manager khud tijori pe maujood tha, ya us ki chabi ki duplicate ban chuki hai.

clues.label: Chabi wala
clues.text: Bazaar ka ek chabi wala kehta hai: 'Aisi tijori ki chabi ki duplicate main 2 ghante mein bana sakta hun.'

clues.label: Cashier gayab
clues.text: Cashier chori ki raat se phone band kar ke gayab hai.

clues.label: CCTV
clues.text: Camera mein raat 2 baje do saaye tijori ki taraf jate dikhe.

clues.label: Manager ka ghar
clues.text: Manager ka ghar bank se sirf 5 minute ki walk pe hai.

cases.explain:
Tijori ke liye manager wali chabi (ya us ki duplicate) lazmi hai. Asli chabi jeb mein thi - toh ya jeb wala khud wahan tha, ya duplicate bani. 'Duplicate zaroor bani' ek chance ko pakki baat bana deta hai - yehi is sawal ka trap hai.

🪤 *Jaal:* Chabi wala, gayab cashier aur do saaye - har clue ek 'pakki' kahani banata hai, lekin sawal yeh tha ke 100% pakka kya hai.

cases.title: ATM ka Claim
cases.brief: Customer: 'Mera ATM card kal raat 9 baje Karachi mein chori hua aur 9:30 pe chor ne 50,000 nikal liye.' Record: paise 9:30 pe Lahore ke ATM se nikle aur PIN pehli dafa mein sahi laga. Clerk: 'Claim jhoota hai - aadhe ghante mein card Karachi se Lahore nahi pohanch sakta.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat clerk ki baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Card ka data aur PIN copy kar ke kisi bhi sheher mein duplicate card banaya ja sakta hai.
Customer 10 saal se bank ke saath hai aur kabhi koi shikayat nahi ki.
Customer ne chori ki report police mein bhi likhwayi hai.
Lahore ke us ATM ka camera us raat kharab tha.
cases.answer: Card ka data aur PIN copy kar ke kisi bhi sheher mein duplicate card banaya ja sakta hai.

clues.label: Gold customer
clues.text: Customer ne 10 saal mein ek dafa bhi late payment nahi ki; bank ne usay 'Gold' rating di hai.

clues.label: Foran FIR
clues.text: Customer ne raat 10 baje hi police mein FIR katwa di thi.

clues.label: Camera ka raaz
clues.text: Lahore wale ATM ka camera usi raat kharab hua - aur agle din khud hi theek ho gaya.

clues.label: Security alert
clues.text: Is mahine bank ne 3 ATM machines se ajeeb chhote devices utaare hain.

cases.explain:
Clerk ne maan liya ke paise nikalne ke liye asli card ka Lahore pohanchna zaroori hai. Agar card ki copy ban sakti hai toh us ki baat ki buniyad hi khatam. Acha record aur police report customer ko shareef dikhate hain, clerk ki logic ko nahi torte.

🪤 *Jaal:* Gold rating aur foran FIR customer ko shareef dikhate hain, camera ka raaz shak dalta hai - lekin clerk ki logic sirf 'asli card' pe khari thi.

cases.title: Viral Photo
cases.brief: WhatsApp pe ek photo viral hai: 'Aaj Karachi mein barf pari!' Aap ka reporter: 'Photo asli hai. Main ne expert se check karwaya - is mein koi editing nahi hui. Foran chhaap dete hain.'
cases.question: Chhaapne se pehle kaunsa sawal poochhna sab se zaroori hai?
options: Yeh photo kab aur kahan li gayi thi?
Photo bhejne wala banda bharose ke qabil hai ya nahi?
Kya doosre akhbaar bhi yeh photo chhaap rahe hain?
Photo kis mobile ya camera se li gayi?
cases.answer: Yeh photo kab aur kahan li gayi thi?

clues.label: Bhejne wale
clues.text: Photo ek retired judge ne group mein bheji - woh kabhi galat cheez forward nahi karte.

clues.label: Breaking news
clues.text: Do bare news channel 15 minute se yehi photo 'Breaking' ke saath chala rahe hain.

clues.label: Photo ki quality
clues.text: Photo itni saaf hai ke barf ka har zarra dikh raha hai - naye iPhone se li gayi lagti hai.

clues.label: Peeche ka board
clues.text: Photo mein peeche ek dukaan ka board dhundla sa hai - 'Mall Road' jaisa kuch likha hai.

cases.explain:
'Editing nahi hui' ka matlab sirf itna hai ke photo asli hai - yeh nahi ke woh aaj ki aur Karachi ki hai. Purani asli photo bhi jhooti khabar ban sakti hai. Bhejne wale ka imandaar hona is khatre ko nahi rokta.

🪤 *Jaal:* Judge sahab, do channel aur saaf photo - teeno bharosa dilate hain. Sawal yeh tha ke photo kab aur kahan ki hai; board ne ishara de diya tha.

cases.title: Ice Cream aur Doobna
cases.brief: Reporter ki khabar: 'Jin mahinon mein ice cream zyada bikti hai, unhi mahinon mein doobne ke waqiaat bhi zyada hote hain. Sabit hua ke ice cream khane se doobne ka khatra barh jata hai.'
cases.question: Is khabar ki logic mein sab se bari galti kya hai?
options: Dono cheezein garmi ki wajah se barhti hain: log ice cream bhi zyada khate hain, nahate bhi zyada.
Reporter ne sirf ek hi sheher ka data dekha hai.
Bohat se log ice cream khaye baghair bhi doob jate hain.
Reporter ne ice cream bechne walon se baat nahi ki.
cases.answer: Dono cheezein garmi ki wajah se barhti hain: log ice cream bhi zyada khate hain, nahate bhi zyada.

clues.label: Sirf Karachi
clues.text: Reporter ke paas sirf Karachi ka data hai - Lahore ya Islamabad ka bilkul nahi.

clues.label: 40% ne nahi khayi
clues.text: Pichle saal doobne wale 40% logon ne us din ice cream nahi khayi thi.

clues.label: Dukaandar
clues.text: Ice cream walon se poochha toh bole: 'Hamari ice cream ka doobne se kya taalluq?'

clues.label: Sab se zyada kab
clues.text: Data ke mutabiq dono cheezein June mein sab se zyada hoti hain.

cases.explain:
Do cheezon ka saath barhna yeh sabit nahi karta ke ek ki wajah doosri hai. Yahan dono ki wajah teesri cheez hai: garmi. 'Sirf ek sheher' wali baat sahi lagti hai, lekin sau sheheron ka data bhi yehi galti dohrata.

🪤 *Jaal:* 'Sirf Karachi ka data' sab se zyada sahi lagta hai - lekin sau sheheron ka data bhi wohi galti dohrata. June wala clue garmi ki taraf ishara tha.

cases.title: Mukhbir ki Khabar
cases.brief: Shak 3 musafiron pe hai aur sona in hi mein se ek ke paas hai. Mukhbir: 'Jis ke paas sona hai us ne ticket cash pe liya hai, aur woh Dubai se aaya hai.' Record: Rafiq - Dubai se aaya, ticket card se liya. Usman - Doha se aaya, ticket cash pe liya. Mrs. Khan - Dubai se aayin, ticket ka record nahi mila.
cases.question: Agar mukhbir ki dono baatein sach hain, toh kaunsa jawab sahi hai?
options: Sona Mrs. Khan ke paas hai, aur unhon ne ticket cash pe liya tha.
Sona Usman ke paas hai, kyunke record mein sirf usi ne cash pe ticket liya.
Sona Rafiq ya Mrs. Khan mein se kisi ke paas hai - dono Dubai se aaye hain.
Mukhbir ki khabar galat hai, kyunke cash wala musafir Doha se aaya.
cases.answer: Sona Mrs. Khan ke paas hai, aur unhon ne ticket cash pe liya tha.

clues.label: Usman ka bag
clues.text: Usman ke bag se 3 naye mobile nikle, aur woh officer se nazar nahi mila raha tha.

clues.label: Rafiq ka maazi
clues.text: Rafiq pe 2019 mein sona smuggle karne ka case chal chuka hai.

clues.label: Mukhbir ka bhai
clues.text: Mukhbir ka bhai pichle mahine customs ke haathon pakra gaya tha - usay customs se nafrat hai.

clues.label: Mrs. Khan
clues.text: Mrs. Khan 70 saal ki hain aur wheelchair pe hain; un ka beta unhein lene aaya hai.

cases.explain:
Dono shartein ek saath chahiye: cash ka ticket AUR Dubai. Rafiq ne card diya, Usman Doha se aaya - dono bahar. Bachi Mrs. Khan, toh un ka ticket cash ka hi hoga. 'Sirf Usman ne cash diya' wala jawab bhool jata hai ke Mrs. Khan ka record mila hi nahi.

🪤 *Jaal:* Usman ki ghabrahat, Rafiq ka purana case aur Mrs. Khan ki umar - sab dil se faisla karwate hain. Mukhbir ki do shartein sirf ek pe poori utarti hain.

cases.title: Kelon ka Container
cases.brief: Container ke papers mein likha hai: '18 ton kele'. Lekin weight 26 ton nikla. Malik: 'Farq barf ka hai. Kelon ko thanda rakhne ke liye 8 ton barf rakhi thi, aur barf ka weight papers mein nahi likha jata.'
cases.question: Kaunsi baat malik ki is baat ko sab se zyada galat sabit karti hai?
options: Container ka fridge 20 din se band hai, andar 35 degree - barf kab ki pighal chuki hoti.
Malik pehle bhi ek dafa galat papers pe jurmana bhar chuka hai.
Usi jahaz ke doosre kele walon ne barf nahi rakhi thi.
8 ton barf khareedna bohat mehnga parta hai.
cases.answer: Container ka fridge 20 din se band hai, andar 35 degree - barf kab ki pighal chuki hoti.

clues.label: Malik ka jurmana
clues.text: Malik pe pichle saal galat papers ka Rs 5 lakh jurmana hua tha.

clues.label: Doosre containers
clues.text: Usi jahaz ke 9 doosre kele wale containers mein kisi ne barf nahi rakhi.

clues.label: Barf ki qeemat
clues.text: 8 ton barf ki qeemat kelon ki aadhi qeemat ke barabar hai.

clues.label: Container ka meter
clues.text: Container ke meter pe likha hai: 'Cooling: OFF - Day 1'.

cases.explain:
35 degree mein 20 din baad barf bach hi nahi sakti, toh 8 ton ka farq barf nahi ho sakta. Purana jurmana aur doosron ka barf na rakhna sirf shak barhate hain - malik ki baat ko seedha galat sabit nahi karte.

🪤 *Jaal:* Purana jurmana aur doosre containers malik pe shak dalte hain - lekin seedha saboot meter tha: barf 20 din tak bach hi nahi sakti.

cases.title: Akbari Sikka
cases.brief: Ek sahab 'Akbar badshah ke zamane ka sikka' bechne aaye hain. Kehte hain: 'Is ki chandi ka test hua hai - 96% pure nikli, bilkul waisi jaisi Akbar ke sikkon mein hoti thi. Is liye sikka asli hai.'
cases.question: Is baat ki logic mein sab se bari galti kya hai?
options: Pure chandi aaj bhi milti hai - test se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sikka kab bana.
Chandi ka test sirf ek hi lab ne kiya hai.
Bechne wala khud purane sikkon ka expert nahi hai.
Akbar ke kuch sikkon mein chandi 96% se kam bhi hoti thi.
cases.answer: Pure chandi aaj bhi milti hai - test se yeh pata nahi chalta ke sikka kab bana.

clues.label: Lab kis ki hai
clues.text: Sirf ek lab ne test kiya - aur woh lab bechne wale ke cousin ki hai.

clues.label: Bechne ka andaz
clues.text: Bechne wala sikke ka naam bhi theek se nahi bol pa raha aur bohat jaldi mein hai.

clues.label: Museum ke sikke
clues.text: Museum ke 40 asli Akbari sikkon mein chandi 94 se 97% tak hai.

clues.label: Saddar ka sunar
clues.text: Saddar ke sunar ki dukaan pe 96% pure chandi aaj bhi aam mil rahi hai.

cases.explain:
Test sirf yeh batata hai ke chandi pure hai - yeh nahi ke sikka 450 saal purana hai. Wohi chandi aaj bhi sikke mein dhaali ja sakti hai. Doosri lab se bhi yehi result aata, is liye 'ek lab' asal galti nahi.

🪤 *Jaal:* Cousin ki lab sab se bara jaal hai - lekin agar test bilkul sahi bhi ho, tab bhi pure chandi se sikke ki umar sabit nahi hoti.

cases.title: Darbar ki Painting
cases.brief: Ek painting aayi hai: 'Mughal darbar, san 1650'. Lab ki report: aasman mein jo neela rang hai woh 'Prussian blue' hai, jo 1704 mein pehli dafa bana. Baqi sare rang wohi hain jo 1650 mein use hote the.
cases.question: Report se kaunsi baat sab se pakki hai?
options: Kam az kam aasman wala hissa 1704 ke baad paint hua - chahe repair ho ya poori painting naqli ho.
Poori painting 1704 ke baad bani hui naqli painting hai.
Painting asli hai; aasman baad mein kisi ne repair kiya.
Lab ka test galat hai, kyunke baqi sab rang purane hain.
cases.answer: Kam az kam aasman wala hissa 1704 ke baad paint hua - chahe repair ho ya poori painting naqli ho.

clues.label: 95% purane rang
clues.text: Painting ke 95% hisse mein 1650 wale purane rang hain - sirf aasman alag hai.

clues.label: Bechne wale ka record
clues.text: Bechne wale ne pichle saal 3 'Mughal' paintings bechi thin - teeno baad mein naqli niklin.

clues.label: Lab ka pehla case
clues.text: Lab ne yeh test pehli dafa kisi Mughal painting pe kiya hai.

clues.label: Prussian blue
clues.text: Prussian blue rang 1704 mein Berlin mein ek rang banane wale ne pehli dafa banaya tha.

cases.explain:
Report se sirf itna pakka hai ke aasman 1704 ke baad paint hua. Poori painting naqli hai ya sirf repair hui - dono ho sakte hain, is liye dono 'pakke' jawab report se aage nikal jate hain. Sab se pakka jawab wohi hai jo utna hi kahe jitna sabit hai.

🪤 *Jaal:* 95% purane rang 'repair' ki taraf kheenchte hain aur bechne wale ka record 'naqli' ki taraf - lekin report sirf aasman ke baare mein pakki hai.
